definitions.price: Median value per m2 of family dwellings sold in the 12 months ending in Q4 of the year (INE, 2022 method)
definitions.income: Median declared gross income per tax household (IRS Modelo 3; INE local income statistics)
definitions.m2_per_income_year: Median income / median price per m2: floor area that one year of median gross household income would pay for at the median price. A ratio of medians from two different populations; not the years needed to buy a dwelling
definitions.price_income_index: (P_t / P_base) / (Y_t / Y_base) * 100: relative change only, not a level
definitions.gap_log_points: 100 * ln(P_end/P_start) - 100 * ln(Y_end/Y_start); positive = prices rose faster

price.title: Valor mediano das vendas de alojamentos familiares nos últimos 12 meses (Metodologia 2022 - €/ m²) por Localização geográfica (NUTS - 2024) e Categoria do alojamento familiar; Trimestral - INE, Estatísticas de preços da habitação ao nível local (Metodologia 2022)
